target_customer: Industrial buyers of welded assemblies (pressure vessels, skids, pipeline systems), including aerospace and energy
problem: Complex weld jobs are slow to bid and schedule and quality is inconsistent; Jeevy acts as the contractor, routes jobs to a network of shops and gives clients schedule and QA visibility.
business_model: Fabrication contractor with software, margin on jobs routed to network shops

founders.name: Jeevesh Konuru
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led 8 engineers on cryogenic loading systems and managed $110M for the Starship propellant loading system template.

founders.name: Vinay Konuru
education: Princeton, computer science and electrical engineering
founders.background_notes: YC page says he won top prize at Princeton Research Day 2023. American Bazaar describes the founders as brothers.

technical_complexity.rationale: Converting drawings to bills of materials and resource loaded schedules is standard engineering with hard parts, while running real fabrication with ASME code compliance adds operational complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Certified shop network and quality records help, but a 3 person team with a shop-based model has limited scale and software is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A January 2026 trade feature says Xometry and Fictiv focus on CNC machining and sheet metal rather than complex weld work; no incumbent action found.

market_need_then: Welded fabrication for aerospace and energy needs certified shops and code compliance; a trade feature argues existing quoting marketplaces do not cover it, and the company claims bid time cuts of over 80%.

branding.domain_note: Uses jeevyfabrication.com, the full name as the domain.

identity.visual_style: Minimal industrial page with name and tagline only

branding.community_and_virality: Launch coverage in American Bazaar (May 2025) and a Huge Magazine feature; no community evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Sparse site and limited coverage; the name seems likely derived from the founder's name but no source says so.

outcome_analysis: Jeevy Fabrication is an Active Spring 2025 company run by two brothers with SpaceX and Rondo Energy backgrounds, operating as a weld contractor out of Texas. No exit, distress or priced round was found. The stage label of Growth in the directory is not supported by any source I found.
notes: Funding unverified: Simplify and ZeroG list a single seed of about $130K (June 2025) with no investors; not recorded as a round. Directory stage Growth is unsupported. Competitor list left empty: Xometry and Fictiv sources found were undated or from 2026. Location varies (Cleburne TX per YC, Cocoa FL per aggregators). Claims of SpaceX and Joby clients on Simplify are unverified. Company site had only a name, logo and tagline. UPDATE (completeness pass): a $130K seed is recorded from a single database (Simplify); the June 2025 date comes from Premier Alternatives, which instead shows $500K with a note that its data is not fully imported. No investors named.
